category_gaps.opportunity: Few exhibitors currently showcase pure‑AI platforms, yet AI is becoming a decisive factor for product differentiation and responsible gambling. Securing AI‑focused exhibitors will attract operators looking for next‑gen tech.

Lottery operators are under‑represented despite the rapid growth of hybrid sportsbook‑lottery products in Europe and LATAM. Adding dedicated lottery exhibitors can broaden the event’s appeal to regulators and operators.

result.timing_note: Begin outreach in early April (Q2) to align with ICE/iGB’s exhibitor registration deadline (typically early May) and to give prospects ample time to plan product launches, secure booth space, and arrange speaking opportunities.
